2121456615622860809.en_summary: David Friedberg speculates Jensen Huang was 'taken out' because he opposed government control of AI. “I do worry that there is legislation coming our way with the new Congress that is going to say every AI chip and every computer and every data center has a switch and has a connection back to some central system. And that central system will be a state system. And we are fundamentally looking at an Orwellian state explosion if this sort of thing happens. And my guess is that people know Jensen’s philosophy. Jensen has talked a lot about AI being for the benefit of all of humanity, regardless of your country, regardless of your standing, regardless of your wealth. He was anti-oligopoly. He was the opposite of the oligarchy. And the central state, the totalitarian state, represents everything that I believe Jensen was against. And because of that, I think he had to be taken out if ultimately the goal is to have the totalitarian state use this technology as a tool. I really do worry about that being the reason. Because at the end of the day, whoever comes in next has to be cooperative with legislatures and work out a bill that we all agree to, head nodding, standing in front of Congress and saying, ‘You know what? I agree with these new ideas. Let’s all go do this.’ And suddenly the US government has control of the actual physical chips that exist in free markets and exist in data centers around the world. And that’s not a great place for any of us.”
2121456615622860809.zh_summary: David Friedberg 推測 Jensen Huang 被「拿下」是因為他反對政府控制 AI。「我確實擔心新國會將有立法說每個 AI 芯片、每台電腦和每個數據中心都有開關並連接到某個中央系統。而那個中央系統將是國家系統。如果這類事情發生，我們基本上在看一個奧威爾式國家爆炸。我的猜測是人們知道 Jensen 的哲學。Jensen 談了很多關於 AI 為全人類的利益，無論你的國家、地位、財富。他反對寡頭。他是寡頭的反面。中央國家、極權國家代表我相信 Jensen 反對的一切。因此，我認為如果最終目標是讓極權國家使用這項技術作為工具，他必須被拿下。我真的擔心那是原因。因為最終，下一位必須與立法機構合作制定我們都同意的法案，點頭，站在國會前說『你知道嗎？我同意這些新想法。讓我們都去做。』突然美國政府控制了存在於自由市場和全球數據中心的實際物理芯片。那對我們任何人來說都不是好地方。」

2121456144384442697.en_summary: Via AI: "No. South Africa is not a fascist state. It is a constitutional multi-party democracy (often rated a “flawed democracy”) with competitive elections, an independent judiciary, a free press, and regular transfers or sharing of power. Fascism, as historically understood (Mussolini’s Italy, Nazi Germany, and close variants), features a one-party dictatorship, extreme ultranationalism, suppression of opposition and free institutions, a leader cult, militarized society, and heavy state control subordinating individuals and markets to the nation or race. South Africa does not match this."
2121456144384442697.zh_summary: 透過 AI：「不。南非不是法西斯國家。它是一個憲政多黨民主（常被評為「有缺陷的民主」），有競爭性選舉、獨立司法、自由媒體，以及定期的權力轉移或共享。法西斯主義，如歷史上理解的（墨索里尼的意大利、納粹德國及相近變體），特徵是一黨獨裁、極端民族主義、壓制反對和自由機構、領袖崇拜、軍事化社會，以及沉重國家控制使個人和市場服從於國家或種族。南非不符合這個。」

2121451595896652080.en_summary: David Friedberg says Jensen Huang should return as Nvidia CEO if he broke no laws and shareholders choose to look past any conduct violations. “Here’s my speculation. If it is found to be the case that Jensen did not violate any laws, I would argue that Jensen should return as CEO. And I think that any violation of code of conduct, any failure to make disclosures or attestations to the board as he should have done, perhaps in this particular context with this particular business and this particular individual, the shareholders can make a decision to see past all that and bring him back, if he didn’t violate the law. If he broke the company code of conduct and so on, the shareholders can make their choice about whether it’s appropriate or not. But I think there’s obviously the question of who’s the best CEO to run Nvidia is probably Jensen.”
2121451595896652080.zh_summary: David Friedberg 說如果 Jensen Huang 沒有違反任何法律，且股東選擇忽略任何行為違規，他應該回歸擔任 Nvidia CEO。「這是我的推測。如果發現 Jensen 沒有違反任何法律，我會主張 Jensen 應該回歸擔任 CEO。我認為任何行為準則違反、任何未能向董事會做披露或證明，也許在這個特定背景下與這個特定業務和這個特定個人，股東可以決定忽略所有這些並把他帶回，如果他沒有違反法律。如果他違反了公司行為準則等等，股東可以選擇是否適當。但我認為顯然有誰是運行 Nvidia 的最佳 CEO 的問題，可能是 Jensen。」

ticker_notes.NVDA: 若未違法，股東可選擇讓 Jensen 回歸
